purpose: Identify completed abandonment-to-recolonization cycles in identity-resolved stable SMP breeding SiteIDs using only provider-confirmed explicit zero/positive states, before any abundance magnitude is used.

state_definition.vacant: direct observed count == 0 exactly, only after provider confirmation that such rows are surveyed nil returns

vacancy_spell.abandonment: occupied in complete calendar year t and explicit zero in t+1
vacancy_spell.recolonization: after one or more consecutive explicit-zero complete years, first later complete calendar year with count > 0
vacancy_spell.completeness: every retained SiteID must be observed in every year used by the spell under the frozen panel roster
vacancy_spell.no_gap_rule: every year from abandonment transition through recolonization transition must be calendar-consecutive and complete; do not bridge an unobserved year
vacancy_spell.multiple_spells: allowed; all qualifying completed spells retained
vacancy_spell.first_colonization: not part of the primary test because no within-site abandonment threshold exists to pair against it
vacancy_spell.transition_gap_years: recolonize_from - abandon_from; because both transitions are consecutive-year transitions, this equals the separation between their transition midpoints.

phase_null_support.contiguous_block: Each completed spell is assigned to the maximal calendar-consecutive complete-year block of its frozen species x MasterSite panel that contains the entire spell.
phase_null_support.reason: Provides at least six distinct circular phase alignments for the structured common-phase null; threshold frozen before SMP magnitude outcomes.
phase_null_support.eligibility: Only spells contained in a maximal calendar-consecutive state-complete block of >=6 years enter Stage C.

vacancy_spell.state_complete_year_rule: Within the provider-confirmed zero-semantics interval, start from inherited Stage-A complete years and retain only years with one usable direct positive/explicit-zero state for every retained SiteID. Missing/unparseable records remove the year; they are never converted to zero.
vacancy_spell.state_complete_minimum: Before spell scanning a panel must retain >=10 state-complete years spanning >=12 calendar years.

allowed_outputs_before_magnitudes: number of completed spells by site/panel/species
contiguous complete-year block start/end/length for each completed spell
state-complete year identities/count/span for each panel/spell

identifiability_gate.master_site_count_definition: distinct provider-resolved physical master_site_key values, not species x MasterSite panels or display-name strings
identifiability_gate.minimum_species_rationale: The confirmatory exact species-level sign-flip test cannot attain one-sided p<=0.05 with four species (minimum 1/16=0.0625); five species permit 1/32=0.03125.
identifiability_gate.requirement: All replication conditions must pass after restricting to provider-confirmed explicit-zero spells contained in >=6-year maximal contiguous state-complete blocks.

decision.if_passed: After identity-resolved structure and provider/official zero-semantics confirmation both pass, freeze the exact phase-null-eligible completed-spell roster and authorize one magnitude-opening hysteresis execution.
decision.if_failed: Stop the hysteresis route. Do not infer zero semantics, lower identity/cycle/phase thresholds, or bridge missing years.

identity_requirement: Input roster must be the output of the frozen SiteID identity gate; unresolved, merged, split, overlapping, boundary-changed, retired or replaced SiteIDs are ineligible.
zero_semantics_requirement: Stage B is unauthorized until the provider-confirmation JSON has all three semantic booleans true, non-empty confirmation_source, integer compatible_start_year/end_year within 1986-2024, end>=start, and a non-empty compatible_record_family_or_era.
